cx-DIBi.title: Coverage: golf course trekker
cx-DIBi.summary: A walking trekker on a golf course on the northeast coast. The car also drove on this golf course in places.

cx-Wzpv.title: Coverage: many walking-trail trekkers
cx-Wzpv.summary: Lots of small walking-trail trekkers across the island, mostly in thick foliage, with occasional beaches and lookouts.

cx-XuYJ.title: Bollard: white, red front reflector
cx-XuYJ.summary: Simple white post with a red reflector on the front and a grey one on the back. Same as mainland Australia, as are the speed signs and green sign backgrounds.

cx-bapH.title: Location: small island south of Java
cx-bapH.summary: A small island south-southwest of Java. It belongs to Australia, so it counts as Australia in streaks. Don't confuse it with the Cocos Islands, a bit further west.

differs.how: Cocos (Keeling) Islands lie a little west of Christmas Island

cx-fsLu.title: Google car: silver pickup truck bed
cx-fsLu.summary: You see the bed of a silver pickup truck at the bottom of the screen. This unique car alone tells you it is Christmas Island.

cx-iIEF.title: Coverage: trekker blur on coastal road
cx-iIEF.summary: On the coastal Jln Pantai road a backpack trekker was used, so you see only a blur and no car at the bottom.

cx-lGDi.title: Coverage: boat trekker on north coast
cx-lGDi.summary: A boat camera near the north coast, with the white deck showing through the blur. It hugs a steep, rocky coastline.

cx-n2Na.title: Landscape: towns in the northeast
cx-n2Na.summary: Built-up areas are in the northeast. The rest of the island is mostly dense forest.

cx-p6bw.title: Landscape: dense forest, white sandy soil
cx-p6bw.summary: Thick tropical forest, with bright white sandy soil on some unpaved roads. A few built-up areas and some palms too.

cx-p88a.title: Coverage: trekker among red crabs
cx-p88a.summary: Famous for red crabs. Near Ethel Beach a trekker walks among hundreds of them, and signs across the island mention the crabs.

cx-t2i9.title: Coverage: rough rural trails
cx-t2i9.summary: Besides normal roads, the Google car also drove very rough rural trails.

cx-xSfX.title: Landmark: harbour with large cranes
cx-xSfX.summary: The harbour area is easy to spot by its large cranes, visible from many places.
